text:
maria: heads-up — new quantized reranker with score-squash blended into ensemble shows positive ndcg@10 overall but MRR regressions on navigation traffic. digging.

alex: what's the slice breakdown?

maria: short output from eval run:
```
all: ndcg@10 +2.1, mrr -0.1
nav: ndcg@10 +0.4, mrr -0.8
informational: ndcg@10 +3.5, mrr +0.6
faq: ndcg@10 -0.3, mrr -1.2
```

maria: root cause looks like score dynamic range shifted because the quantized head + new layer compresses logits.

priya: so maybe purely a calibration problem. can we rescale before mixing with legacy scores?

dave: yes — we saw this with opt-rewrite last year. isotonic regression per-slice helped.

eva: lightweight plan: fit monotonic mapping (isotonic/histogram) on holdout per intent slice and apply in scoring tier.

alex: share the eval command you used.

maria: eval cmd:
```
./eval_harness.py --scorers legacy,new --dataset prod_holdout_v2 --metrics ndcg@10,mrr --slices intent_slices.json --out outputs/scan_newvlegacy.json
```

maria: quick snippet used to fit isotonic:
```python
from sklearn.isotonic import IsotonicRegression
ir = IsotonicRegression(out_of_bounds='clip')
ir.fit(new_scores, labels)
new_rescaled = ir.transform(new_scores)
```

priya: train isotonic pooled or per-slice? pooled might mask nav shift.

dave: per-slice if sample size >= 5k queries; otherwise fallback to pooled + slice-specific offset.

eva: also consider per-rank calibration for top1 sensitivity — ndcg impacted by early ranks.

maria: per-rank deltas from the run:
```
rank 1: new -0.9%
rank 2: new +0.2%
ranks 3-10: new +3.8%
```

priya: MRR drop explained. options: reweight nav in calibration or keep legacy top1 for nav via rule.

dave: fallback rule is low-risk: serve legacy top1 on nav intents, use new reranker for rerank. ugly but avoids user impact.

alex: deployment constraints? can scoring tier apply LUT per-slice cheaply?

maria: yes — plan:
- fit isotonic per-slice on holdout
- upload per-slice LUT to scoring service
- canary 5% for 24h, monitor ndcg@10, mrr, click-through on nav
- rollback if nav_mrr drops > 0.5%

maria: requesting +1 from eng-platform to reserve canary window tomorrow.

priya: +1 from me; please include dataset hash and config in PR.

dave: +1; also add logs for pre/post score distribution (histogram by slice).

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary/score-rescale -> 2025-11-14T09:00Z (5% traffic) by @maria

maria: I'll open PR with LUT serializer and eval artifacts. thanks all.
